name: Per-voxel Projection (Object-order)
aliases: Object order voxel projection with value-sorted array
definition: An object-order voxel-projection method loops through the volume and projects all non-zero voxels in value-sorted order, with each voxel contributing to exactly one pixel.
summary: Per-voxel projection is an object-order technique that projects voxels onto the image plane, using value-sorted order to efficiently compute Maximum Intensity Projection via simple overwrites.
